newsitem.title: CHINA: Weifu Fuel first-half net drops 2.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Weifu Fuel first-half net drops 2.3 pct.

text.p: (In millions of yuan unless stated, against 1996 figures):
Earnings per share 0.18 yuan vs 0.18 yuan
Net assets per share 2.51 yuan vs 2.29 yuan
Company name: Weifu Fuel Injection Co Ltd.

Note: The results, compiled according to Chinese accounting standards except for net profits which were based on international standards, were published in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times on Monday.
Based on international accounting standards, the company's net profits were 29.83 million yuan for the first half of 1997 compared with 33.20 million in the year-ago period, it said. ($1 = 8.3 yuan)
